_about: Tool inventory for issue #13 (Architecture Defense): every art, audio, video and packaging tool the team chose, each driven by an agent through tools/assetgen.py (a script, CLI or API), with its licence. 2D art is painted with an image model (D-new-art-image-model, Josh, 12 Nov): tools/assetgen.py image, default provider gemini (GEMINI_API_KEY), openai optional (OPENAI_API_KEY); every paid call counts its cost (price_usd_per_image, the provider's published price) against the hard per-run cap IMAGE_SPEND_CAP_USD (no cap set = no paid call), and no pre-jam image is ever an input (GDD ART-03, BG-02). Blender stays for real 3D and frame-consistent motion (pipeline/art/blender/, tools/assetgen.py blender and image --provider blender). tools/assetgen.py, tools/connections.py, tools/mcp_config.py and audio_check.py read it. env = the variable that overrides the command path (tests point it at a stub); app_paths = install folders searched when the command is not on PATH. licence = the terms the provenance row records; [VERIFY] = not yet confirmed against the vendor's current terms (a human confirms before the asset ships; audio_check and the credits list carry it). Agents never call an API with a key: kickoff runs the API steps (tools/assetgen.py fulfil) and the keys never enter an agent session.
